text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, Hishi 
Miracle mentioned she had some business at 
the station.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to Bubbly Land with my friends 
now!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: And for free, at that! The reason being—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! 3rd prize! You've won 
tickets to Bubbly Land!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
An invitation ticket? That's the grand 
prize! Congrats~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It looks like a few of us can go 
together, so you should come too, Mirako! 
To Bubbly Land!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...So, I'm thinking of inviting other 
friends too, and having fun together!"
choice_data_list: I thought you weren't good at swimming...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's true that I'm not good at swimming... 
but you can still have plenty of fun 
without getting in the water.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, what's with that look? It's not 
like I'm forcing myself to hang out with 
you, you know."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My friend won the lottery and was so 
happy. ...Seeing that made me really 
happy, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, matching pace with your friends 
is totally normal. I'm sure they 
accommodate me at times, too."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that what ordinary friendship is 
supposed to be like?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah―― Oops, am I interrupting?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all. I was just out with Trainer a 
minute ago, so we just walked to the 
station together."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
In that case, why don't you join in too, 
Trainer? Think of it as continuing our 
outing!
choice_data_list: No, you should go have fun with everyone.

No, you guys go ahead and have fun 
together.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't be so stiff! It's way more 
fun with a big crowd!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, since both of them are saying so, 
let's go together, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any reason to refuse, so I 
think I'll take them up on their offer and 
tag along.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Doesn't the lazy river here look 
super fast?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well then, maybe I'll grab some juice and 
relax for a bit—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
A break already? Come on! Let's play. How 
about volleyball?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Neither of you are going to swim?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Ehh~, you want to go swimming?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's not it, but... we came all the way 
to the pool, so not swimming seems like a 
waste...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Mirako, you're not good at swimming, 
right? I thought something out of the pool 
might be better!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Since we all came together, it'd be a 
waste if we didn't all enjoy ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally! There's no way we're 
leaving anyone out!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: You two...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. If that's the case! I want to go to 
the water slide!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you gonna be okay? Even if you 
don't swim, you'll still get splashed 
quite a bit.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Then let's skate while covering the front 
and back! That should keep some of the 
spray off, right?

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Yaaahooo!! Ahahahahaha!! Ah-hahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Aaah, my nose still stings...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay? Just wait here. I'll go buy 
us some warm drinks.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
That was terrifying... You really don't 
expect to almost drown on a waterslide, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... But that speed and that floating 
sensation! I think I might get hooked on 
it! Skating was so much fun~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, today was so much fun! Let's all go 
again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Maybe I'll bring a floatie next 
time~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Man, I think you're still gonna get 
splashed even with a swim ring, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Friends with whom one can be totally at 
ease and natural... Watching the three of 
them, I was deeply moved by what a 
wonderful dynamic they had.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aah, I'm beat... But you know, I kinda 
like that tired feeling after hanging out 
with everyone. I wanna go back to Bubbly 
Land again.
choice_data_list: Shall we bring water guns next time?

If I'd kept going, maybe I'd have gotten 
good at swimming?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. That way we can cool off with 
water, and it'll feel like we're playing 
in a pool too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely bringing this along next 
time I go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, that means we're going to 
practice swimming, right?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "I don't wanna! Absolutely not~!"
